title: EXHIBITION SHOW FLOOR
description: POPC Live! will feature a massive expo hosting the biggest brands, publishers, studios and amazing artists and creators! Check out new game demos, posters, figures or get your hands on the latest merch and goodies!

title: INDUSTRY CONFERENCE
description: Hear from some of the biggest names in the gaming and entertainment industry. Our two-day industry conference will give you a detailed insight into the latest news in game development, the role of cryptocurrency in gaming, how e-sports are evolving and much more

title: COSPLAY CHAMPIONSHIP
description: Witness the best cosplayers from across the region battle it out for glory and amazing prizes in our grand championship event! Show off your creativity and craftsmanship.

title: ESPORTS TOURNAMENT
description: Top gaming teams compete in high-stakes tournaments. Join the audience and cheer for your favorites as they battle for the ultimate title in professional gaming.

title: GAMING WORKSHOPS
description: Learn from the pros! Interactive sessions covering game design, streaming techniques, and competitive strategies for aspiring gamers and developers.

title: ARTIST ALLEY
description: A dedicated space for independent artists to showcase and sell their unique creations, from digital art to hand-crafted merch and collectibles.

title: RETRO ARCADE ZONE
description: Take a trip down memory lane in our retro arcade. Play classic games that defined a generation and experience the nostalgia of early gaming culture.

title: MEET & GREET
description: Get up close and personal with your favorite influencers, pro players, and community icons. An exclusive opportunity for photos and autographs.

title: COLLECTIBLES EXPO
description: Explore a vast collection of rare toys, comics, and memorabilia. A must-visit for collectors and fans of pop culture history.
